peak_days: Wednesday (Day 1 - Arrival of Saralamma), Thursday (Day 2 - Arrival of Sammakka), Friday (Day 3 - Peak Alankaram/Offerings), Saturday (Day 4 - Vanapravesham/Return)
peak_seasons: Biennial Maha Jathara (Magha Sudha Purnima in February)
average_wait_time: 15 to 30 minutes on regular non-Jathara days and mini-Jathara weekends
peak_wait_time: 2 to 4 hours on Day 1 & Day 2; 6 to 10+ hours on Day 3 (Peak Friday) during peak ritual hours
recommended_visiting_hours: Early morning hours (3:00 AM – 6:00 AM) or mini-Jathara period (1–2 weeks prior to the main festival)
crowd_management_notes: Recognized as Asia's largest tribal gathering with over 1.5 crore (15 million) devotees over four days. Peak density occurs on Day 3 when Sammakka and Saralamma are both present on the Gaddelu (altars). Multi-km holding queue complexes, dedicated holding zones, 52 RTC bus sectors, and one-way traffic regulation loops (Pasra-Medaram-Tadvai) are enforced to manage vehicular and pedestrian movement.
